app.name: Check First
app.tagline: Got a message asking for money or papers? Check it here before you pay anyone.

form.messagePlaceholder: Paste a text, WhatsApp message, or write what the caller said…
form.empty: Paste a message or add a screenshot first.
form.badImage: That file isn't a PNG or JPG picture.
form.tooLong: That message is very long. Only the first {max} characters will be checked.

summary.low: We didn't find common scam signs. Still, never pay or share documents until you're sure who you're dealing with.
summary.medium: This message has some warning signs. Don't pay or share personal information until you verify it.
summary.high: This looks like a scam. Do not pay, do not reply, and do not share any personal information.

result.heading: Result
result.rulesLayerHint: Runs on your phone. Works without internet.
result.aiLayerHint: Reads the whole message with Claude AI.
result.finalNote: We show the higher of the two results to keep you safe.
result.verifyHint: Use these official websites. Never use a phone number or link from the message itself.

fallback.offline: You're offline, so only the rules check ran.
fallback.ai_failed: The AI check didn't finish in time, so this result uses the rules check only.
fallback.not_configured: The AI check isn't set up on this server, so this result uses the rules check only.
fallback.rate_limited: Too many checks in a minute. This result uses the rules check only.
fallback.bad_request: The AI check couldn't read this input, so this result uses the rules check only.
fallback.imageOnly: We couldn't read the screenshot without the AI check. Please paste the message text too.

urgency.title: Threats or a rush
urgency.explanation: Scammers threaten arrest, deportation or a closed account so you act before you think.

payment.title: Strange way to pay
payment.explanation: Real agencies never ask for gift cards, crypto, wire transfers, Zelle or Western Union.

government.title: Says it's the government
government.explanation: USCIS, IRS, SSA, ICE and police do not call or text to demand money.

guarantee.title: "Guaranteed" visa or job
guarantee.explanation: No one can guarantee a visa, green card or job abroad — only the government decides.

upfront_fee.title: Pay first
upfront_fee.explanation: Asking for a fee before you receive anything is a classic scam trick.

secrecy.title: Keep it secret
secrecy.explanation: Being told not to tell anyone is a sign someone wants to stop you from getting help.

notario.title: Notario or consultant
notario.explanation: In the US, a notario cannot give legal advice or file immigration cases for you.

prize.title: Prize or lottery
prize.explanation: You can't win a contest you never entered, and real prizes don't cost money.

link.title: Suspicious link
link.explanation: Links in surprise messages often lead to fake sites that steal money or passwords.

low: If it asks for money or documents later, check again before acting.
Contact the person or company using a number you already know.
medium: Don't pay and don't share personal information yet.
Contact the agency or company yourself using the official website below.
Talk to a family member you trust before doing anything.
high: Do not pay — especially not with gift cards, crypto, wire or Zelle.
Do not reply, call back, or click any link in the message.
Contact the real agency using the official website below.
Warn your family so they don't fall for it.

shareText: ⚠️ Scam warning from Check First: a message like this was rated {risk}. Don't pay or share personal information. Check messages yourself at {url}
